title: Compatible choice of natural adic purity and finite scalar comparisons

from.place: Imported Proof, Step 2 (Qbar-stage): transport is well defined by independence in finite coefficient extensions; the integral naturality and scalar square needed before rationalization (unit Step 3)

statement:
Fix a prime $p$, an integer $a\geq1$, $q=p^a$, the field $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, and an algebraic closure $k$ of $k_0$, as in [def-pur-conventions]. Fix a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside a fixed algebraic closure, with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a smooth separated morphism of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ between separated finite-type $k$-schemes, with smoothness and relative dimension as in [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], finite type as in [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and separatedness as in [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Use the derived-complete integral constructible category of [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], its normalized DVR reduction towers [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower], and the full subcategory $D^b_{ctf}(-,\mathcal O_E)$ defined by a single Tor-amplitude interval for all reductions [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Use the integral pullback and completed tensor of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], the exceptional inverse image of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], and the twists of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Put
$$H_E(K)=Lf_E^*K(d)[2d],\qquad G_E(K)=Rf_E^!K.$$
There is a simultaneous choice, for all finite coefficient fields $E$ and all $K\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\mathcal O_E)$, of isomorphisms $\gamma_{E,K}:H_E(K)\to G_E(K)$ having exactly the finite reductions specified in [thm-pur-adic-reconstruction], such that their components form an $\mathcal O_E$-linear natural transformation $H_E\Rightarrow G_E$ for each $E$ and satisfy the coefficient equations below. Here $H_E$ and $G_E$ are exact $\mathcal O_E$-linear functors on these integral finite-Tor categories, with exactness as in [def-weil-triangulated-category] and linearity as in [def-weil-linear-functor].

For every finite extension $E\subset F$ inside the fixed algebraic closure, write $C_{F/E,W}(K)=K\otimes^L_{\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}}\widehat{\mathcal O}_{F,W}$ for ordinary derived change of completed coefficient rings on $W=X,Y$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. On derived-complete inputs it is canonically identified with the strict inverse-limit integral scalar extension of [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension] by the natural isomorphism $\chi_{F/E,K}$ of [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison]. All the following comparisons are expressed for this ordinary derived-tensor presentation; their associators are its tensor associators. There are canonical exact natural comparison isomorphisms
$$a_{F/E}:C_{F/E,X}H_E\xrightarrow{\sim}H_FC_{F/E,Y},\qquad b_{F/E}:C_{F/E,X}G_E\xrightarrow{\sim}G_FC_{F/E,Y}.$$
Here $a$ is the pullback, tensor, twist and shift comparison. Use the compact-support functors $Rf_{!,E}$ and $Rf_{!,F}$ of [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support] and their canonical coefficient comparison $c_{F/E}:C_{F/E,Y}Rf_{!,E}\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_{!,F}C_{F/E,X}$. Writing $\epsilon_{E,K}:Rf_{!,E}G_EK\to K$ for the counit of the exceptional adjunction [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], the component $b_{F/E,K}$ is the adjoint transpose of the explicitly typed composite
$$Rf_{!,F}C_{F/E,X}G_EK\xrightarrow{c_{F/E,G_EK}^{-1}}C_{F/E,Y}Rf_{!,E}G_EK\xrightarrow{C_{F/E,Y}(\epsilon_{E,K})}C_{F/E,Y}K.$$ They satisfy
$$b_{F/E,K}\circ C_{F/E,X}(\gamma_{E,K})=\gamma_{F,C_{F/E,Y}K}\circ a_{F/E,K}.$$
Write $\alpha^W_{L,F,E}:C_{L/F,W}C_{F/E,W}\xrightarrow{\sim}C_{L/E,W}$ for the tensor associator on $W=X,Y$. Under the canonical identification $C_{E/E,W}\cong\operatorname{id}$ on derived-complete objects, the comparisons for $F=E$ are identities. For finite coefficient fields $E\subset F\subset L$, they satisfy
$$a_{L/E,K}\circ\alpha^X_{L,F,E,H_EK}=H_L(\alpha^Y_{L,F,E,K})\circ a_{L/F,C_{F/E,Y}K}\circ C_{L/F,X}(a_{F/E,K}),$$
$$b_{L/E,K}\circ\alpha^X_{L,F,E,G_EK}=G_L(\alpha^Y_{L,F,E,K})\circ b_{L/F,C_{F/E,Y}K}\circ C_{L/F,X}(b_{F/E,K}).$$
Under the canonical shift comparisons, $a_{F/E,K[1]}=a_{F/E,K}[1]$ and $b_{F/E,K[1]}=b_{F/E,K}[1]$. The purity square is an equality of natural transformations compatible with these unit, composition and shift equations.

source.place: Step 3, scalar-extension transitivity presupposed in passing from E to Qbar; extracted integral compatibility assertion
source.note: Agent auxiliary statement. Finite-level trace-transpose construction: SGA 4, Expose XVIII, 2.13.2 and 3.2.1--3.2.5, especially 3.2.3 (literature/sga/SGA4-expose-18_reedition.pdf). No Stacks tag states this adic compatibility. The simultaneous compatible choice is an additional assertion; it is not inferred for arbitrary lifts from pointwise reconstruction or equality of reductions.
